# So Many Apps. One Idea. {.sdaia-dark background-gradient="linear-gradient(135deg, #1C355E, #00C9A7)"}

::: {data-id="intro" style="background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12); padding: 1.5em; border-radius: 12px; text-align: center; font-size: 1.2em;"}
ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cowork… The names change. The **two layers** don't.
:::

. . .

::: {style="text-align: center; margin-top: 0.5em;"}
Pick by the **job**, not the logo.
:::

# Chat vs. Agent {.sdaia-dark background-gradient="linear-gradient(135deg, #1C355E, #9B8EC0)"}

The one split that matters

## Two Very Different Things {auto-animate=true}

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
::: {style="background: #f7f9fc; padding: 1.2em; border-radius: 12px; border-left: 4px solid #FF7A5C;"}
**A Chat Assistant**

- You paste, it replies
- Lives in a browser tab
- Great for thinking, drafting, Q&A
:::
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
::: {style="background: #f7f9fc; padding: 1.2em; border-radius: 12px; border-left: 4px solid #00C9A7;"}
**An Agent**

- Opens your **files**, runs **steps**
- Can **act**, not just talk
- Does the actual work — that's Cowork
:::
:::
::::

. . .

::: {style="text-align: center; font-weight: bold; margin-top: 0.5em;"}
You've spent the week in an **agent**. Both have their place.
:::

# The Apps at a Glance {.sdaia-dark background-gradient="linear-gradient(135deg, #1C355E, #FF7A5C)"}

The chat trio · the agents

## Roughly How They Compare {auto-animate=true}

::: {style="font-size: 0.78em;"}
| | Name | Best for |
|---|---|---|
| **Chat** | ChatGPT (OpenAI) | All-rounder; huge app ecosystem |
| **Chat** | Claude (Anthropic) | Long documents, careful writing |
| **Chat** | Gemini (Google) | Tight with Gmail / Docs / Drive |
| **Agent** | **Cowork** (Anthropic) | Easiest setup — **our tool** |
| **Agent** | Antigravity (Google) | Similar feel; close to Google stack |
| **Agent** | Hermes | Deepest controls — technical staff |
:::

. . .

::: {style="text-align: center; color: #00C9A7; font-weight: bold; margin-top: 0.4em;"}
Use what your organization provides. The **workflow** you learned transfers to any of them.
:::

# Beyond the Chat Box {.sdaia-dark background-gradient="linear-gradient(135deg, #1C355E, #9B8EC0)"}

A map by the job in front of you

## When You Need to Make… {auto-animate=true}

::: {style="font-size: 0.78em;"}
| The job | Reach for | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| **Voice / narration** | ElevenLabs | Natural text-to-speech, dubbing |
| **Video** | Veo · Runway · Sora | Generate / edit short video clips |
| **Images** | Midjourney · DALL·E · Firefly | Art and visuals from a description |
| **Slides & design** | Gamma · Canva Magic | Outline → finished deck or graphic |
| **Meeting notes** | Otter · Fireflies · Granola | Auto-transcribe + summarize calls |
| **Writing polish** | Grammarly · Notion AI | Tone, clarity, in-doc drafting |
| **Connect apps** | Zapier · Make | Glue tools together, no code |
:::

. . .

::: {style="text-align: center; margin-top: 0.4em;"}
Your **agent already covers** summaries, drafts, and data — reach out only when it genuinely
can't (voice, video, polished art). Pick **one** per job; don't collect them.
:::

# One Rule When App-Hopping {.sdaia-dark background-gradient="linear-gradient(135deg, #1C355E, #FF7A5C)"}

The Newspaper Test travels with you

## Before You Upload to Any New App {auto-animate=true}

::: {data-id="safe" style="background: #1C355E; color: #ffffff; padding: 1.2em; border-radius: 12px; text-align: center; font-size: 1.1em;"}
Every app and tool has its **own data policy** — many free tiers **train on what you upload.**
:::

. . .

::: {.incremental}
- Don't feed it anything you wouldn't want on the **front page**
- Is it **approved** by your organization?
- When in doubt, **sanitize first** — names, numbers, secrets out
:::

# Optional: When You Can't Use the Cloud {.sdaia-dark background-gradient="linear-gradient(135deg, #9B8EC0, #1C355E)"}

A quick word on local LLMs

## The Privacy Option {auto-animate=true}

::: {data-id="local" style="background: #f7f9fc; padding: 1.2em; border-radius: 12px; border-left: 4px solid #9B8EC0;"}
A **local LLM** runs the model **on your own machine** — nothing leaves your laptop. Tools
like **Ollama** or **LM Studio** make it possible.
:::

. . .

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
::: {style="background: #f7f9fc; padding: 1em; border-radius: 12px; border-left: 4px solid #00C9A7;"}
**Why you'd want it**

Strict privacy; offline; sensitive data that can't go to the cloud.
:::
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
::: {style="background: #f7f9fc; padding: 1em; border-radius: 12px; border-left: 4px solid #FF7A5C;"}
**The trade-offs**

Weaker than the big cloud models; needs a strong computer; more setup.
:::
:::
::::

. . .

::: {.callout-note}
## For most people, most of the time
The approved cloud tools + the Newspaper Test are enough. Reach for local only when privacy
**requires** it — and ask IT first.
:::

# Build: Try One New Tool {.sdaia-dark background-gradient="linear-gradient(135deg, #1C355E, #00C9A7)"}

Right now, in the room

## Pick One and Run It {auto-animate=true}

::: {.callout-tip}
## Hands-on (5 minutes)
1. Choose **one** app or tool from the map you don't already use.
2. **Newspaper-Test it first** — sanitize anything sensitive.
3. Run **one real prompt** from your own work.
4. Jot one line: does it beat your current tool for that job?
:::

. . .

::: {style="text-align: center; font-style: italic; margin-top: 0.4em;"}
**Refine:** share with a neighbor — *I like / I wish / I wonder.*
:::

. . .

::: {style="text-align: center; font-weight: bold; margin-top: 0.3em;"}
One new capability you've actually tried beats a bookmarked list of fifty.
:::

## Key Takeaways {.sdaia-dark background-color="#1C355E"}

::: {.incremental}
1. **Pick by the job, not the logo** — the two layers are the same everywhere
2. **Chat vs. agent** is the big split — chat answers, an agent acts
3. **The apps** — chat trio (ChatGPT / Claude / Gemini), agents (Cowork / Antigravity / Hermes)
4. **Go deep on one tool per job** — your agent already covers a lot
5. **The Newspaper Test travels** — check each tool's data policy before you upload
:::
